data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (IMDb, then Rotten Tomatoes, then compose the email with the same subject and body), but it ends with Send where the true workflow says Discard, and it uses friend_email instead of {friend}@example.com. It also uses {friend} in the body without listing it as a parameter, and it never mentions the Mail tab or clicking Body, so an automation built from it would be somewhat ambiguous and could send the email by mistake.
